thread:
noah g.: Heads up — company card declined at check-in so I paid the first night on my personal card. Hotel gave me an email folio that shows a single package line: "ConfPkg - 3 nights - $740.00" with no VAT breakdown or per-night folio. I need to expense nightly hotel + conference add-on. What's acceptable? 
people-ops: Sorry that happened. Two things: 1) Finance needs proof of payment(s) and a folio that ties vendor to dates. If the hotel only issues a single package line, ask them for an itemized folio showing each night and any taxes/VAT. 2) If they can't provide VAT lines, Finance will reimburse but mark VAT as non-recoverable. Please attach both the card statement and the folio. 
julia s.: Also confirm whether the "conference" portion was vendor-billed to the hotel or a 3rd-party registration. If it's included, we treat the conference fee as a separate non-hotel business expense — requires the conference invoice or registration confirmation. 
noah g.: It's a bundle — booking site shows a package "Room + Summit Pass" and the confirmation email names the summit but no separate invoice. Hotel says the bundle is all they bill. 
omar e.: If the vendor can't itemize, Finance will accept a vendor email attesting to bundle details + proof of payment. For the personal-card night, include a short attestation that company-card was declined at check-in and you covered night 1 personally and were reimbursed by the company. 
people-ops: Important: if the bundle includes a non-travel service (conference) and it's an eligible corporate expense, Finance will require the attendee's name on the conference roster. If that's not available, attach the summit confirmation screenshot showing your name. 
finance-bot: Rule check: personal-card used due to company-card decline -> attach folio + merchant email + cc statement lines; finance will reimburse the full vendor total and post VAT flagging if no VAT breakdown. Ticket #FIN-4922 opened. 
noah g.: For per-diem: because I checked in late on day 1 (evening), do I claim full per-diem for that day? 
julia s.: Per policy: first/last travel day is 75% per-diem if travel includes overnight and the day is partial. If you arrived after 8pm for overnight, you still get full hotel nights but per-diem prorate applies. Upload itinerary to substantiate arrival time. 
omar e.: Also — since one night was on your personal card, Finance will reimburse room nights and any directly billed conference fees. For the vendor bundle, if VAT cannot be reclaimed, the net amount is still reimbursable. 
noah g.: Uploaded folio email, a screenshot of the booking site showing bundle line, and my personal card statement line. Tagged @finance and @people-ops. 
people-ops: Thanks — Finance will respond in-thread if they need the roster or an attestation. We'll add a one-line template to the travel FAQ for "hotel bundle / no folio" cases. 
finance-bot: FIN-4922 update: Received attachments. Expect reimbursement in the next run (3-5 business days). If hotel provides itemized folio later, reply here to update the ticket. 
noah g.: Cheers, thanks all :coffee:
